verdict.rationale: Convertio's own docs say its video converter lets users choose quality, aspect ratio, codec and other settings, and that it supports conversions among 300+ formats, so video transcoding with codec control is documented. Bitrate is only implied by "quality", aspect ratio is not resolution, and audio-specific transcoding controls are never described. Missing for 10: explicit bitrate control, explicit resolution control, documented audio codec/bitrate settings, independent or hands-on corroboration.
